hero.title: Engineering Excellence.
hero.subtitle: MBSC Australia delivers world-class engineering consultancy, technical training, and digital solutions. From Australia to the Middle East, we partner with industry leaders to ensure operational integrity and workforce capability.

intro.title: Your Partner in Engineering Excellence
intro.body: MBSC Australia is a specialist engineering consultancy serving the oil & gas, mining, and infrastructure sectors. We combine deep technical expertise with innovative digital solutions to help organisations achieve operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and workforce development.

servicesPreview.sectionSubtitle: Strategic consultancy and technical services for the world's most demanding industries.

projectsCta.title: Ready to discuss your next project?
projectsCta.subtitle: Our engineering consultants are available for deployment across Australia, the Middle East, and Europe.

projects.pageSubtitle: Delivering engineering excellence across Australia, the Middle East, and beyond.

p1.title: Pilbara Rail Expansion
p1.description: Comprehensive geotechnical investigation for 400km of new heavy-haul rail alignment in Western Australia's Pilbara region.
p1.outcome: Delivered 3 weeks ahead of schedule, enabling early track laying and cost savings for the client.

p2.title: Perth CBD High-Rise
p2.description: Foundation pile testing and vibration monitoring for a 50-storey tower in Perth's central business district.
p2.outcome: Verified pile integrity to AS 2159 standards with zero defects, ensuring structural safety.

p3.title: Offshore Platform Integrity
p3.description: Comprehensive integrity assessment and non-destructive testing of platform jacket legs using phased array ultrasonics.
p3.outcome: Identified critical fatigue cracking early, enabling preventative maintenance and avoiding costly downtime.

p4.title: Highway Bridge Assessment
p4.description: Advanced GPR scanning and concrete strength assessment for aging bridge assets across regional NSW.
p4.outcome: Mapped all reinforcement positions, ensuring safe drilling operations for bridge widening works.

p5.title: Moomba Cementing QA for Santos
p5.description: Cementing quality assurance and well integrity services for Santos oil and gas operations at the Moomba gas field.
p5.outcome: Ensured cementing integrity across multiple wells, meeting stringent Santos specifications and industry standards.

p6.title: Olympic Dam Mine Expansion
p6.description: Large-scale geotechnical investigations and structural testing for underground mine expansion at the Olympic Dam copper-uranium operation.
p6.outcome: Delivered critical foundation analysis supporting safe mine expansion, completed ahead of schedule with zero incidents.

p7.title: Melbourne Metro Tunnel
p7.description: Comprehensive structural testing and integrity monitoring for Melbourne's major metro tunnel expansion project.
p7.outcome: Successfully delivered critical testing services ensuring tunnel integrity and passenger safety.

p8.title: West Gate Bridge Strengthening
p8.description: Advanced NDT and structural assessment for reinforcement and reliability improvements on Melbourne's iconic bridge.
p8.outcome: Comprehensive structural analysis enabled targeted strengthening works, extending bridge service life by 25 years.

p9.title: Western Suburbs Pipeline
p9.description: Pipeline integrity testing and monitoring for critical infrastructure improvements in Melbourne's western corridor.
p9.outcome: Delivered comprehensive pipeline integrity assessment ensuring safe, reliable energy supply to growing communities.

p10.title: Port of Melbourne Wharf
p10.description: Marine concrete testing and corrosion assessment for structural remediation of port-side assets.
p10.outcome: Identified critical structural defects and guided remediation works, ensuring continued safe port operations.

services.pageSubtitle: Comprehensive engineering consultancy, training, and digital solutions for oil & gas, mining, and infrastructure sectors.

oilandgas.title: Oil & Gas Engineering Consultancy
oilandgas.short: End-to-end engineering consultancy for upstream and midstream operations worldwide.
oilandgas.full: MBSC Australia provides specialist engineering consultancy for the oil & gas sector. Our team of experienced drilling, reservoir, and production engineers deliver integrated solutions including cementing QA/QC, well integrity diagnostics, production optimisation, and asset integrity management. We support major operators across Australia, the Middle East, and Europe.

training.title: Global Technical Training Programs
training.short: Industry-leading training programs delivered worldwide to upskill your technical workforce.
training.full: We design and deliver comprehensive technical training programs for organisations seeking to develop their engineering capabilities. Our certified instructors provide NDT certification, safety leadership, and specialist technical courses both on-site and through virtual platforms. Programs are tailored to meet Australian Standards, ISO requirements, and regional compliance needs.

digital.title: Integrated Engineering & Digital Solutions
digital.short: Advanced digital platforms and AI-driven solutions for engineering data management.
digital.full: MBSC Australia delivers innovative digital solutions that transform how organisations manage engineering data and operations. Our integrated platforms combine real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and AI-powered insights to enhance decision-making. We help clients digitise workflows, optimise asset performance, and leverage data for competitive advantage.

mining.title: Mining & Geology Technical Services
mining.short: Comprehensive geological and geotechnical services for the resources sector.
mining.full: Supporting the complete mining lifecycle from exploration through to rehabilitation. Our geologists and geotechnical engineers provide site investigations, geological modelling, tailings dam monitoring, and structural assessments. We deliver the technical expertise needed for safe, efficient, and compliant mining operations.

safety.title: Safety, Compliance & Workforce Development
safety.short: Building safer workplaces through compliance excellence and workforce capability.
safety.full: MBSC Australia helps organisations achieve the highest standards of workplace safety and regulatory compliance. We provide safety audits, compliance consulting, and workforce development programs tailored to the oil & gas, mining, and construction sectors. Our approach combines technical expertise with practical implementation to create lasting safety cultures.

training.pageSubtitle: Developing world-class technical capability through industry-leading training. We deliver specialised programs for NDT certification, safety leadership, and engineering excellence to organisations across Australia, the Middle East, and Europe.

hybrid.title: Flexible Learning

ndt.title: NDT Certification (Level 1 & 2)
ndt.description: Comprehensive training in ultrasonic testing, magnetic particle inspection, and dye penetrant methods according to ISO 9712 certification standards.

safety.title: Safety Leadership for Engineers
safety.description: Risk management and safety leadership workshops designed for site supervisors and engineering managers in high-risk environments.

gpr.title: Advanced GPR & NDT Interpretation
gpr.description: Master radargram interpretation for concrete scanning, utility mapping, and subsurface analysis. Includes practical field modules.

corporate.title: Custom Corporate Programs
corporate.description: Bespoke training programs designed to align your organisation with AS/NZS standards, industry best practices, and specific competency requirements.

cta.title: Develop Your Team's Capabilities
cta.subtitle: Contact our training department to discuss tailored corporate programs and international delivery schedules.

about.pageSubtitle: Engineering excellence built on expertise, integrity, and global capability.
about.overviewBody: MBSC Australia is a specialist engineering consultancy serving the oil & gas, mining, and infrastructure sectors. Our team of senior engineers, geoscientists, and technical specialists partner with major operators, contractors, and government agencies across Australia, the Middle East, and Europe to deliver integrated engineering solutions.
